name: subagent_supervisor
description: Native pi-subagents supervisor channel. Use reply/pending/status to answer child subagent requests without overriding pi-intercom.

action.description: List pending requests, inspect status, or reply to a request.

to.description: Unique request id prefix, agent or child target; replyTo takes precedence.

message.description: Reply text; required for reply. Interviews need JSON matching the requested shape.

replyTo.description: Exact pending request id; omit only with one matching request.
